ui.agents.publication.agent_not_found.he.note: The listing this app meant to update has been delisted from the hub. Short headline; the body says the delisting is likely and the offered action refreshes the hub.

ui.agents.publication.category.credentia.tone: plain, factual; names the rule that was broken without moralising

ui.agents.publication.fallback.headline.note: The catch-all headline for a refusal this build cannot type: an older backend's prose, or a code this version does not know. Deliberately says only that it did not happen.
ui.agents.publication.fallback.headline.tone: plain, says nothing it cannot know

ui.agents.publication.hub_unauthorized.b.note: PUBLISH surface. Two sentences: nothing landed, then the remedy and the next step. The pull twin says the same about a pull, so keep the pair parallel and do not merge them.
PULL surface twin of the publish sentence: nothing was pulled, sign in again, then pull again. Keep the two verbs ('publish' / 'pull') distinct - a pull does not publish anything.
ui.agents.publication.hub_unauthorized.b.role: body of the hub-unauthorized refusal, pull surface

ui.agents.publication.hub_unauthorized.h.note: The hub answered that this machine's credential is not acceptable. The remedy is running the Radient sign-in again, offered as a button.

ui.agents.publication.hub_unavailable.bo.note: Fallback used when the hub sent no sentence worth showing. Names the outcome and offers a retry, plus updating an out-of-date backend. Publish surface; keep parallel with the pull twin.
ui.agents.publication.hub_unavailable.bo.role: body of the hub-unavailable refusal, publish surface

ui.agents.publication.hub_unavailable.bo.note: PULL surface twin: nothing was pulled, retry later, update the backend if needed.
ui.agents.publication.hub_unavailable.bo.role: body of the hub-unavailable refusal, pull surface

ui.agents.publication.hub_unavailable.he.note: The hub did not complete the publication, for either of two causes (no answer, or an answer the transport routes here), so the headline must not claim a reach failure.
ui.agents.publication.hub_unavailable.he.tone: warning, does not assert a cause

ui.agents.publication.hub_unavailable.he.note: PULL surface twin of the publish headline. Same rule: names the outcome, never the cause.
ui.agents.publication.hub_unavailable.he.role: headline of the hub-unavailable refusal, pull surface
ui.agents.publication.hub_unavailable.he.tone: warning, does not assert a cause

ui.agents.publication.insufficient_role..note: PUBLISH surface without the hub naming a rank: says 'a higher role than yours' instead. Keep parallel with the with-role twin.
ui.agents.publication.insufficient_role..role: body of the role refusal, no rank named

ui.agents.publication.insufficient_role..note: PULL surface twin without a named rank.
ui.agents.publication.insufficient_role..role: body of the role refusal, no rank named, pull surface

ui.agents.publication.insufficient_role..note: PUBLISH surface, and the hub named the rank it needs: {required} is that rank as the hub spells it (a data token such as 'admin' - do not translate the value). Two sentences: what is needed, then who can change the role.
ui.agents.publication.insufficient_role..role: body of the role refusal, with the hub's required role

ui.agents.publication.insufficient_role..note: PULL surface twin with the hub's required rank at {required} (data token; do not translate the value).
ui.agents.publication.insufficient_role..role: body of the role refusal with rank, pull surface

ui.agents.publication.insufficient_role..note: The reader is a member of the organization but their role is too low for this action.

ui.agents.publication.invalid.field.cate.note: The categories field was refused and the hub sent no rule text. Field label only.
ui.agents.publication.invalid.field.cate.role: body sentence naming the refused field, no rule

ui.agents.publication.invalid.field.cate.note: Categories field label plus the hub's own rule text at {rule}.
ui.agents.publication.invalid.field.cate.role: body sentence naming the refused field and the hub rule

ui.agents.publication.invalid.field.desc.note: The description field was refused and the hub sent no rule text, so only the label is left - a bare label plus a period, which is what English shows. Not a place to invent a rule.
ui.agents.publication.invalid.field.desc.role: body sentence naming the refused field, no rule

ui.agents.publication.invalid.field.desc.note: Description field label plus the hub's own rule text at {rule}. Keep the label first in English.
ui.agents.publication.invalid.field.desc.role: body sentence naming the refused field and the hub rule

ui.agents.publication.invalid.field.inst.note: The instruction field was refused and no rule text came back, so the sentence states the known bound itself. {max} is a character count, passed as a plain digit string (never add thousands separators in English).
ui.agents.publication.invalid.field.inst.role: body sentence naming the refused field and its bound

ui.agents.publication.invalid.field.inst.note: The instruction field was refused and the hub sent its own rule text, inserted verbatim at {rule}. Keep the field label first in English.
ui.agents.publication.invalid.field.inst.role: body sentence naming the refused field and the hub rule

ui.agents.publication.invalid.field.name.note: The validator refused the NAME field and sent no rule text, so the sentence stands alone. Field label first, as English does; a locale may need another order and should write its own sentence rather than transpose word by word.
ui.agents.publication.invalid.field.name.role: body sentence naming the refused field

ui.agents.publication.invalid.field.name.note: Field label plus the hub's own rule text (server English, inserted verbatim): {rule} reads like 'must be 3-64 characters'. Keep the label first in English; another locale may reorder with its own phrasing. Ends with a period.
ui.agents.publication.invalid.field.name.role: body sentence naming the refused field and the rule

ui.agents.publication.invalid.field.tags.note: The tags field was refused and the hub sent no rule text. Field label only.
ui.agents.publication.invalid.field.tags.role: body sentence naming the refused field, no rule

ui.agents.publication.invalid.field.tags.note: Tags field label plus the hub's own rule text at {rule}.
ui.agents.publication.invalid.field.tags.role: body sentence naming the refused field and the hub rule

ui.agents.publication.invalid.field.tool.note: The tools field was refused and the hub sent no rule text, so only the label is left. Not a place to invent a rule.
ui.agents.publication.invalid.field.tool.role: body sentence naming the refused field, no rule

ui.agents.publication.invalid.field.tool.note: Tools field label plus the hub's own rule text at {rule}. Keep the label first in English.
ui.agents.publication.invalid.field.tool.role: body sentence naming the refused field and the hub rule

ui.agents.publication.invalid.field.when.note: 'When to use' is the name of a field in the agent document, not a question to the reader. Refused with no rule text.
ui.agents.publication.invalid.field.when.role: body sentence naming the refused field, no rule

ui.agents.publication.invalid.field.when.note: 'When to use' is a field name; {rule} is the hub's own rule text. Keep the field name recognisable as the same label the form uses.
ui.agents.publication.invalid.field.when.role: body sentence naming the refused field and the hub rule

ui.agents.publication.invalid.headline.note: The hub's validator refused the document on a field. Headline only; the body names the field and the rule.

ui.agents.publication.local_failure.head.note: The failure happened on this machine, before the hub was asked anything, so no listing can exist. Publish surface.
ui.agents.publication.local_failure.head.tone: warning, names the machine as the failing side

ui.agents.publication.local_failure.head.note: PULL surface twin of the local-failure headline: the team could not be pulled from this machine.
ui.agents.publication.local_failure.head.role: headline of the local failure, pull surface
ui.agents.publication.local_failure.head.tone: warning, names the machine as the failing side

ui.agents.publication.moderation_rejecte.note: A reviewer read the instructions and refused them. Headline only - the body below it is the reviewer's own sentence, which is server text and is never translated.

ui.agents.publication.moderation_unavail.note: Three short sentences: the review did not run, nothing landed, a retry in a minute is right. Must not imply the agent was rejected.
The review service did not run, so nothing was published and nothing about the agent was judged. Warning register, never danger: the author's work is not at fault.

ui.agents.publication.name_claim_in_flig.note: Says nothing is claimed yet and a retry is usually enough. {name} is the submitted name in straight double quotes; a locale may use its own pair.
ui.agents.publication.name_claim_in_flig.role: body sentence of the in-flight name claim refusal

ui.agents.publication.name_claim_in_flig.note: A different fact from 'taken': another publication holds this name's short-lived reservation and is probably about to finish. Warning register, because the name is usually free moments later.
ui.agents.publication.name_claim_in_flig.role: headline of the in-flight name claim refusal

ui.agents.publication.name_reserved_buil.note: Two DIFFERENT names: {name} is what the author submitted, {builtin} is the built-in definition that reserves it. Keep the two quotes around each; a locale may pick its own pair. The second sentence is the rule.
ui.agents.publication.name_reserved_buil.role: body sentence of the reserved-name refusal, names differ

ui.agents.publication.name_reserved_buil.note: The common case: the submitted name IS the built-in's name, so one name is stated once. {builtin} carries whichever spelling the hub canonically uses.
ui.agents.publication.name_reserved_buil.role: body sentence of the reserved-name refusal, one name

ui.agents.publication.name_reserved_buil.note: The submitted name belongs to a definition that ships with the app, which the hub reserves. Short headline; the body carries the two names.

ui.agents.publication.name_taken.body.note: Explains why the name cannot be used: hub agent names are globally unique. {name} is the submitted name, quoted by the sentence itself with straight double quotes; a locale may switch to its own quotation pair.
ui.agents.publication.name_taken.body.role: body sentence of the name-taken refusal

ui.agents.publication.name_taken.headlin.note: The headline of a refusal: another account already published an agent under this name. The remedy is the name field, so the body names that. Sentence case, no final period (headline).
ui.agents.publication.name_taken.headlin.role: headline of a refusal panel in the publish dialog

ui.agents.publication.name_taken.owned_b.note: Says the author owns the listing already and points at updating it. {name} is the submitted name, in straight double quotes that a locale may replace.
ui.agents.publication.name_taken.owned_b.role: body sentence of the name-taken refusal, own listing

ui.agents.publication.name_taken.owned_h.note: The sibling headline for the case where the SAME account already owns that name, so nothing is wrong - the author just needs to update the existing listing rather than create a second one. Must read as a next step, not an error.
ui.agents.publication.name_taken.owned_h.role: headline of the name-taken refusal, own listing

ui.agents.publication.not_a_member.body.note: PUBLISH surface. Nothing landed, and the only way forward is an owner inviting the reader - so the sentence points there rather than offering a retry that would loop.
ui.agents.publication.not_a_member.body.role: body of the membership refusal, publish surface

ui.agents.publication.not_a_member.body_.note: PULL surface twin: nothing was pulled, and an organization owner can invite the reader.
ui.agents.publication.not_a_member.body_.role: body of the membership refusal, pull surface

ui.agents.publication.not_a_member.headl.note: The signed-in account is not in the organization it tried to act in.

ui.agents.publication.not_owner.body.note: One sentence naming whose the listing is. Says nothing about the agent's content, which is not at fault.

ui.agents.publication.not_owner.headline.note: This app remembered a hub listing that belongs to a different account, so updating it is refused. The remedy offered is publishing as a new listing.

ui.agents.publication.other_action_lead.note: Prefixes the reason for an action that failed without a coded treatment. Followed by the local server's own sentence, so this must end with a full stop.
ui.agents.publication.other_action_lead.role: lead sentence of a failure explanation

ui.agents.publication.payload_too_large..note: The same refusal without the hub's limit: names the outcome and the remedy only. Second sentence is the remedy.
ui.agents.publication.payload_too_large..role: body of the payload-too-large refusal, no limit

ui.agents.publication.payload_too_large..note: {size} is a kibibyte count the hub sent, passed as a plain digit string beside the unit 'KiB', which stays as it is in every locale. Second sentence is the remedy.
ui.agents.publication.payload_too_large..role: body of the payload-too-large refusal, with the hub's limit

ui.agents.publication.payload_too_large..note: The document exceeded the hub's size ceiling. The remedy is shortening the instructions, which the body names.

ui.agents.publication.pull.busy.note: The hub answered 429: busy, and a retry later is right. {subject} is the quoted name.

ui.agents.publication.pull.hub_unavailab.note: The hub did not complete the download for either of two causes (no answer, or an answer the transport routes here), so the sentence names the outcome rather than a reach failure.
ui.agents.publication.pull.hub_unavailab.role: pull-refusal sentence, hub did not complete
ui.agents.publication.pull.hub_unavailab.tone: plain, does not assert a cause

ui.agents.publication.pull.incomplete.note: The hub answered 5xx: it started the work and failed its own side. A retry later is right.

ui.agents.publication.pull.no_reason.note: The refusal carried no usable reason at all. Shortest sentence in the family: says only that the download did not happen.
ui.agents.publication.pull.no_reason.tone: plain, says as little as it can

ui.agents.publication.pull.not_found.note: The hub no longer holds the document, so nothing was downloaded. {subject} is the quoted name (or the stand-in). Delete nothing: the second clause is the 'nothing landed' fact.

ui.agents.publication.pull.prose.note: An authored sentence the hub or backend wrote, shown after the colon with the quoted name first. {reason} is server text, never translated.
ui.agents.publication.pull.prose.role: pull-refusal sentence carrying the server's own words

ui.agents.publication.pull.reach_failure.note: The prose arm's reach-failure sentence: no answer at all arrived. Distinct from hub_unavailable, which covers a hub that answered.
ui.agents.publication.pull.reach_failure.role: pull-refusal sentence, transport failure, prose arm

ui.agents.publication.pull.refused.note: Generic pull refusal in the typed arm: the hub or backend wrote {reason}, shown verbatim after the colon. {subject} is the quoted name. Keep the colon structure.
ui.agents.publication.pull.refused.role: pull-refusal sentence with the server's reason

ui.agents.publication.pull.refused_downl.note: The hub answered 4xx: it refused the request outright, so the document is not here. No retry is implied.

ui.agents.publication.pull.sign_in_refus.note: The hub answered 401 or 403: this machine's credential was refused. The pull surface offers no sign-in control of its own, so the sentence states the fact only.

ui.agents.publication.pull.unreachable.note: A transport failure after the route's own wrappers were stripped: the hub really was not reached.

ui.agents.publication.subject.agent.note: Stands in for an agent's name when the refusal carried none, inside a longer sentence ('Nothing was published. Ask an owner ...'). Lowercase, because it continues a sentence; keep it short.
ui.agents.publication.subject.agent.role: stand-in subject in a refusal sentence

ui.agents.publication.subject.name.note: The requested name, wrapped in quotation marks, used as the subject of a pull-refusal sentence. The marks themselves are copy: a locale may use its own pair (guillemets, corner brackets) but must quote {name}; {name} itself is never translated.
ui.agents.publication.subject.name.role: quoted subject in a pull-refusal sentence

ui.agents.publication.subject.team.note: Team twin of subject.agent: stands in for a team's name the refusal did not carry. Lowercase, mid-sentence.
ui.agents.publication.subject.team.role: stand-in subject in a refusal sentence

ui.agents.publication.subject.unknown.note: Stands in for the quoted name when the pull did not carry one. Starts with a capital because it opens the sentence here.
ui.agents.publication.subject.unknown.role: stand-in subject in a pull-refusal sentence

ui.agents.publication.team_not_found.bod.note: One sentence hedging the delisting and locating it in time ('since this page was loaded'), so the reader knows a reload may be what changed.

ui.agents.publication.team_not_found.hea.note: A team document was delisted between the list and the press. The offered action refreshes the hub rather than retrying a read that would answer the same.

ui.agents.publication.team_plan_required.note: PUBLISH surface. Explains that sharing agents inside an organization needs the Team plan, and that only an organization owner can activate it. Keep 'Team' as the plan's product name.
ui.agents.publication.team_plan_required.role: body of the plan refusal, publish surface
ui.agents.publication.team_plan_required.tone: plain, points at the person who can act

ui.agents.publication.team_plan_required.note: PULL surface twin: reading an organization's teams needs the Team plan. Keep 'Team' as the plan's product name.
ui.agents.publication.team_plan_required.role: body of the plan refusal, pull surface
ui.agents.publication.team_plan_required.tone: plain, points at the person who can act

ui.agents.publication.team_plan_required.note: The organization's plan does not include the team feature. Warning register, because nothing about the agent is wrong.
